utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Hi Rafael, it's Sam from Vantrellis. I saw your team finished the Harlow Street job last week. How did that land?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Ha, it was a sprint, but we got there. Thanks for asking.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: What's the biggest challenge with time tracking right now?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: It takes too long. Our payroll coordinator spends a full day at every month end on it.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Let me make sure I have this right. Our payroll coordinator spends a full day at every month end on tracking technician hours, and things still slip. Did I miss anything?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: So let me walk you through the platform. There's the scheduling board, which has drag and drop, color coding, and templates. Then there's the mobile app, which works on iPhone and Android, with push alerts and offline mode. We also have reporting, with twelve standard reports and a custom report builder, and we integrate with payroll, accounting, and most CRMs. There's an admin console for permissions, single sign-on, audit logs, and we have a customer success team that does onboarding. We also just launched route optimization and a customer portal, and there's an API if your team wants to build anything custom. Most customers start with the scheduling board and then add modules as they grow.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Okay. What does something like that cost?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: It's twelve thousand dollars a year. But honestly, if you sign this month I can take twenty percent off, so it's really a lot less than that.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Okay. I'll have to think about it.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Does what you've seen so far make sense for your team?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Can you just send me some info and I'll look it over?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Well, honestly, the info won't show you much. We're actually cheaper than most of the market.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Can we put thirty minutes on the calendar with Morgan for Thursday at ten, so you both see it running with your tools?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Thursday at ten works. I'll forward the invite to Morgan.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Thanks Rafael, really appreciate the time.

tone_windows.note: Rep does most of the talking in this stretch.
